messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Turkish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Turkish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Büyük çöldeki onu gördüğümde, «Bana merhamet et» ona bağırdım, «Ne olursan ol gölge ya da kesin insan!» .

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Quando | “when” (temporal subordinator) | **gördüğümde** | “when I saw” | OK | | vidi | “saw” (past, 1st sg) | **gördüğümde** | “I saw” (embedded in the suffix) | OK | | costui | demonstrative “this one (male)” | **onu** | “him/it” | OK | | nel | “in the” (prep + article) | — (expressed by the locative suffix **‑de** in *çöldeki*) | “in the” | **UNNECESSARY** | | gran | “great, large” | **Büyük** | “great” | OK | | diserto | “desert” (large arid region) | **çöl** (appears as **çöldeki**) | “desert” | OK | | «Miserere» | imperative “have mercy” | **merhamet et** | “have mercy” | OK | | di | preposition “on / to” (part of *di me*) | **bana** | “to me” | OK | | me | pronoun “me” (object) | **bana** | “to me” | OK | | gridai | “I shouted / cried out” | **bağırdım** | “I shouted” | OK | | a | preposition “to” (dative) | **ona** | “to him” | OK | | lui | pronoun “him” (dative) | **ona** | “to him” | OK | | qual | “whatever / what” (free relative) | **Ne** | “what/whatever” | OK | | che | relative connector (introduces clause) | — (absorbed in the clause) | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | tu | 2nd person pronoun “you” | **olursan** (contains “sen”) | “if you are” | OK | | sii | subjunctive of *essere* “be” | **olursan** (verb stem *ol*) | “be” | OK | | od (1) | disjunction “or” | **ya** | “or” | OK | | ombra | “shade / shadow” | **gölge** | “shade” | OK | | od (2) | disjunction “or” | **ya** | “or” | OK | | omo | “man / human” (archaic) | **insan** | “human” | OK | | certo | “certain, genuine” | **kesin** | “certain/real” | OK | | **(punctuation)** | source ends with **!** | **!** (kept) | — | **WRONG** (extra period “.” added after the exclamation) |
---
### Items to Review
- **UNNECESSARY**: *nel* (preposition + article), *che* (relative connector) – Turkish naturally omits these elements. - **WRONG**: An additional period “.” was placed after the final exclamation mark, which does not appear in the source text. - **MISSING / GRAMMAR**: None detected.
Correcting the punctuation error (removing the stray period) will bring the Turkish rendering fully in line with the source structure.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Turkish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Turkish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 1** - Original: Büyük çöldeki onu gördüğümde, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 2** - Original: «Bana merhamet et» ona bağırdım, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 3** - Original: «Ne olursan ol gölge ya da kesin insan!» . - Issue: WRONG – extra space before the final period - Corrected: «Ne olursan ol gölge ya da kesin insan!».
